scheduler_source_of_truth: live ChatGPT automation registry for this account
namespace_policy: Only this five-loop stack may write under automation_intelligence/omega_stack/. Other schedulers must use separate namespaces.
global_manifest_policy: Read-only contextual input. Do not use automation_intelligence/manifest.json as this stack's scheduler source of truth and do not overwrite unrelated scheduler topology fields.
persistence_policy: heartbeat.json is the only mutable IN_PROGRESS marker; pass 9 writes immutable history proof; pass 10 promotes latest then writes an immutable finalization receipt binding history/latest blob SHAs; only receipt-verified runs are accepted as fully persisted.

migration.v2_reason: Old agent branch diverged substantially from main; v2 starts from current main and carries only approved design/operational scaffolding.

persistence_bootstrap.rule: No substantive work before verified heartbeat persistence.
github_first_actions: update heartbeat.json with current RUN_ID and IN_PROGRESS
persistence_bootstrap.on_github_bootstrap_failure: Stop substantive work immediately; one fresh-SHA reconcile/retry; then attempt Library failure receipt and stop.
closure: Pass 8 freezes run core/result; it must not claim pass 9/10 completion.
Pass 9 creates immutable history/<RUN_ID>.json with RUN_STATUS=HISTORY_VERIFIED and FINALIZATION_STATUS=AWAITING_LATEST_PROMOTION, then re-fetches and records its blob SHA.

Pass 10 writes latest.json with RUN_STATUS=RUN_PERSISTED and exact same RUN_CORE plus the verified history blob SHA; re-fetches latest and history; verifies identifiers and RUN_CORE equivalence; then writes immutable finalization/<RUN_ID>.json containing the verified history/latest blob SHAs; only after receipt readback may heartbeat become IDLE/FINALIZED.
